actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Xero Practice Manager (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Xero Practice Manager action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Xero Practice Manager connection OAuth scopes: Scopes offline_access practicemanager

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_object
actions.title: Create object
actions.description: Create object in Xero Practice Manager
actions.help: Creates a new object in Xero Practice Manager. First select the object you want to create, then populate the relevant fields for that object.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object. For example, Client .

actions.name: list_object
actions.title: Retrieve list of objects
actions.description: List object in Xero Practice Manager
actions.help: Retrieves a list of object in Xero Practice Manager. First select the object you want to list, then populate the relevant fields for that object.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object. For example, Invoice .

actions.name: update_object
actions.title: Update object
actions.description: Update object in Xero Practice Manager
actions.help: Updates a new object in Xero Practice Manager. First select the object you want to update, then populate the relevant fields for that object.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object. For example, Client .
